text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly identified as a review article in its title and abstract. Its primary focus is synthesizing and discussing models for simulating soil carbon and nitrogen cycles, specifically in the context of land use change between forest and agricultural soils. While it includes a detailed application of one model to illustrate capabilities, this is presented as an example within the broader review context. The paper's central aim is not to conduct a new national-scale LULC prediction, but to review modeling approaches for understanding biogeochemical consequences of LULC change.)
